timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, my name is Loz Kay and I want to be your independent voice for Angcoats in Clayton.
There's a local election coming up and it's important that your voice is heard.
Far too often, Manchester Council ignores residents.
We in the pirate party want to speak up for you.
I want to stand up for you and be your independent voice on the council.
I want to end the blight of born-ed-up shops and home.
Our ward where we live is incredibly varied.
All the way from Clayton Vale, right into the heart of the city with the Northern Quarterm.
I want to make sure that there's real regeneration for all of this ward.
I want to end the blight of born-ed-up houses and shops.
I want to stand up for tenants who are hard pressed by the bedroom tax.
Last time there was a council election, very few equal to a park.
In some areas, only one in five equal to a park.
It's important that your voice is heard and I want to help get to your voice heard.
The council takes lots of important decisions about everything from our environment,
our streets, transport, education.
So it's important that your voice is heard too.
There are parties like the BNP and the UKIP standing in the selection
that seek to split our communities apart.
I want to oppose that.
I want to stand up and represent everyone in this ward.
That is the job of the council after all.
I want to do all of that for you.
It's time for an independent voice.
I can do that.
I can do that if you vote for me, please use your voice.
So give me your vote on the 5th of December.

youtube_description:
Loz Kaye is standing in Ancoats and Clayton ward in Manchester in the council election on the 5th of December.  He wants to make a difference for people in his community.  Its time for an independent voice in Ancoats and Clayton, all the way from the Northern Quarter to Angel Meadow.  People in Ancoats and Clayton deserve better.
